reviewer: independent_review: source-and-reference review; separate from benchmark author

cases.reason: `afterfunc-stop` has second Stop=false and an OPEN scope question, but wrongly asserts any expiry-first Stop returns false despite possible intervening Reset.
`afterfunc-reset` correctly describes first post-expiry reset and overlapping callbacks, but falsely generalizes reset=false after expiry without excluding an intervening reset.

findings.reason: Expiration-first does not guarantee later Stop=false if an intervening Reset rearms; scope_extension_test.go:8-11 confirms expired callback, Reset(false), second Reset(true), Stop(true). Repeated-stop portion and OPEN wording question are correct.

Expiration already launching a callback does not guarantee Reset=false after an intervening rearm; scope_extension_test.go:8-10 confirms false then true while old callback runs. First-reset overlap portion is correct.

Stop/Reset guard and Go1.23 docs support independent running/no-receive cases, immediate subsequent operations after receiving, and legacy drain ambiguity; later Reset after Stop explicitly distinguished.
NewTimer channel allocation, call and C assignment plus After wrapper match source; runtime capacity mechanism remains OPEN.
sendTime comment defines delta and code does nonblocking select of Now minus delta, with default no delivery.
when function uses current clock for nonpositive and clamps negative overflow sum to MaxInt64.
